_about: HeardOS desktop app catalogue (2026-10-18). {domain} = DOMAIN env. access = Authentik application slug: the app shows for people in group app-<access>; null = everyone signed in. embed=false opens in a new browser tab instead of a window (Authentik and Vaultwarden are never framed). allow = the window iframe's permissions policy; default "fullscreen; clipboard-write; publickey-credentials-get", grant more only where the app needs it. icon = dashboard-icons name (fetched into public/icons at image build) or builtin:<name>.
